label: TL2 Null-Vector Control
design_thesis: Exact TL1 combat vector under a TL2 diagnostic identifier; verifies that routing and labels create no hidden advantage.

label: Checkpoint 42 Identity Control
design_thesis: Retains the original identity-preserving package as an upper comparison control without promoting any value.

label: Checkpoint 44 Shield-Tempered Control
design_thesis: Retains the best prior no-shield-increment probe so new micro-refinements can be compared to accepted attribution evidence.

label: Checkpoint 44 Structure-Tempered Control
design_thesis: Retains the prior no-structure-increment probe so the cost of the TL2 shield step remains visible.

label: Defense-Neutral Anchor
design_thesis: Uses moderated fire control, full propulsion, power, weapons, and missile guidance while retaining TL1 Hull, Armor Integrity, and Shield Capacity.

label: Hull-Step Candidate
design_thesis: Adds one Hull point to the defense-neutral anchor while retaining TL1 Armor Integrity and Shield Capacity.

label: Armor-Integrity-Step Candidate
design_thesis: Adds one Armor Integrity point to the defense-neutral anchor while retaining TL1 Hull and Shield Capacity.

label: Hull Step + Conservative Direct Fire
design_thesis: Retains the one-Hull structural step but reduces the direct-fire accuracy increment from five to three percentage points for both direct-fire families.

label: Armor Step + Conservative Direct Fire
design_thesis: Retains the one-Armor-Integrity structural step but reduces the direct-fire accuracy increment from five to three percentage points for both direct-fire families.
